observations: Strict typed JSON discards the nested JsonException path and Console materialization replaces it with /request.
ProgramKitIdentifier and registered schema PKID patterns do not define one common accepted language.
The complete Open Console projection and CLR binding rules are implemented but not delivered as one consumer contract style.
The only complete Console materialization request example is a test fixture outside the installed knowledge closure.
C# gate bind requires a hand-authored candidate lock whose digest, receipt, and ordering semantics are not public.
Generated Directory.Build.targets files are empty while the generated-project gate command invokes ProgramKitVerifyGeneratedProject.
The cold proof assumes 29 already packed packages and the backed pack project accepts only one project with parallelism disabled.
CLI schema selection composes a transitive module closure only for C# gates; architecture/planning external references and design-flow $schema selection are not closed.
